digest.component_or_area: Gerrit project config / Autosubmit label definition and ACL
propositions: Author an Autosubmit project-authored label (distinct from Gerrit's first-party autosubmit submit-plugin) in project.config with range -1..+1, function NoBlock, and empty copyCondition to ensure the label drops on every new patchset.

Grant label-Autosubmit vote ACL to both Contributors (requesters) and Administrators (operator fallback) via two separate lines in [access "refs/heads/*"], mirroring the LLM-Review/Verified pattern, so requesters can set the label under their own identity while admins retain manual set/clear capability.

Capture pre-cutover baseline via GET /a/projects/rebar/access and commit it to infra/gerrit/access-snapshot-pre-autolander.json in the same change that adds the label, ensuring a committed snapshot exists for downstream ADR-0042 security-invariant diffs.

The non-gating Autosubmit label (function NoBlock, no submit-requirement reference) cannot weaken the existing two-vote gate because the bot re-verifies both LLM-Review and Verified votes on the exact tested SHA at submit time.
Post-cutover, verify that GET /a/projects/rebar/access diffs cleanly against the pre-cutover baseline, showing only the two new label-Autosubmit vote grants with no other ACL drift or gate changes.

Inline header comment in the [label "Autosubmit"] block of project.config documents the non-gating invariant, name-collision rationale, and bot re-verification guarantee, and update infra/gerrit/setup-project.sh commit message to reference the Autosubmit label addition for audit trail.
